_doc: Shared canonical Aerodrome V2 pool for the ADR-005 Tier-2 pool-builder dual-driver parity tests (task SSSXG6). Loaded by BOTH rust/crates/degenbot/tests/parity_aerodrome_builder.rs (Rust consumer, BotState directly) AND tests/standalone_parity/test_aerodrome_builder_dual_driver.py (Python consumer, PyBot). A volatile/stable-shared-factory STABLE Aerodrome V2 pool: unidirectional fee (200/10000 = 0.02%), reserves 1e18 / 2e9, at update_block 0. This is the deterministic identity+state TUPLE a PoolBuilder.build_aerodrome_v2 emits after its on-chain I/O (stable()+getFee()+reserves) + CREATE2 verify; the parity asserts BOTH consumers register the SAME canonical fixture and report IDENTICAL pool id + identity (token0/token1/factory/variant/stable/fee) + state (reserve0/reserve1/update_block). A deliberately-wrong edit to THIS file fails BOTH sides mechanically (the shared-fixture contract, HRT356).

fixture._fee_note: getFee() returns the unidirectional fee in basis points; 200/10000 = 0.02%.

expected._pool_id_note: First pool registered in a fresh BotState/PyBot gets deterministic id 1 — both consumers MUST agree, proving the registration identity is identical across the FFI seam.
